build_processing_graph: build a processing graph from a specification dict defining dataset, config, and split processing steps with dependencies
get_processing_step: get a processing step by name from the processing graph, returning a copy that can be safely modified
get_children: get the list of child processing steps that are triggered after a given processing step completes
get_ancestors: get all ancestor processing steps that trigger a given step, directly or transitively
parse_artifact_id: parse an artifact id string into dataset, revision, config, split, and processing step name components
